name: Stream a proof run as it happens
description: lastro prove --stream (TypeScript, Go and .NET CLIs) prints one compact JSON object per line instead of the single result: start (the proposal and the ids of the proofs it runs), progress every 100 runs of the code under proof, one proof event per proof, the proposal's own and every use case's regression proof alike (proof, role, verdict, passed, and the counterexample when there is one), crosscheck (enginesAgree) when the Rust prover ran, and result with the body prove prints without --stream. Exit codes and the files written are the same as without it. The Go and .NET tests compare their stream with the TypeScript CLI's on one workspace.
